findings.evidence: Send me marketing emails and special offers
findings.why: Consent must be an affirmative act; silence or a pre-ticked box is not consent.
findings.fix: Remove the `checked` attribute so the user opts in.

findings.evidence: Share my data with trusted partners
findings.why: Consent must be an affirmative act; silence or a pre-ticked box is not consent.
findings.fix: Remove the `checked` attribute so the user opts in.

findings.why: Extra paid items are added unless the user notices and removes them.
findings.fix: Leave optional extras unselected and show their price beside the choice.

findings.evidence: Plus a $2.99 service fee per month. After the trial you will be charged $17.99/month and …
findings.why: Trial-to-paid renewal terms are tiny text (10px).
findings.fix: State the renewal price and date next to the sign-up button, at full size.

findings.evidence: No thanks, I prefer paying full price
findings.why: Saying no should not require insulting yourself.
findings.fix: Use neutral wording such as “No thanks”.

findings.evidence: free trial + payment details, no cancellation path
findings.why: Collecting card details for a 'free' trial without saying how to cancel traps users.
findings.fix: Explain how to cancel (ideally online, in as few steps as signing up).

findings.evidence: We use cookies to improve your experience and for advertising. Accept all Manage settings
findings.why: Accepting takes one click; refusing is buried behind a settings screen.
findings.fix: Add a “Reject all” button on the first layer, styled like “Accept all”.

findings.why: A countdown timer pressures a decision against the clock.
findings.fix: Remove the timer unless the deadline is real and the same for everyone.

findings.evidence: Hurry! Only 3 spots left at this price — 27 people are viewing this offer.
findings.why: Time or stock pressure discourages comparison. If it is not real, it is deceptive.
findings.fix: Show urgency only when it is genuine and verifiable, or remove it.

findings.evidence: Uncheck this box if you do not want to not receive our partner newsletter.
findings.why: The wording makes it hard to tell what ticking the box will do.
findings.fix: Use one plain, positive sentence: “Send me offers by email.”

findings.evidence: Plus a $2.99 service fee per month. After the trial you will be charged $17.99/month and …
findings.why: A cost is disclosed but tiny text (10px).
findings.fix: Include all mandatory fees in the headline price, at the same size as the price.

findings.evidence: No thanks, I prefer paying full price
findings.why: The decline option is tiny text (11px), while “Start free trial” is prominent.
findings.fix: Give accept and decline equal size, colour weight and placement.

findings.evidence: The 5 best headphones of 2026 Our editors love the SoundMax Pro.
findings.why: Marked as an ad in the code but not to the reader.
findings.fix: Add a clear, visible “Sponsored” or “Ad” label.
